verdict.rationale: Mastra's own docs say workflows can declare a `schedule` field that fires on a specified cron, and that agents can run on a cron cadence. This is a direct, recurring schedule, not a one-off trigger or a background task. Missing for 10: in-depth scheduling docs (timezone handling, managing or pausing schedules, missed-run and retry behavior, durability across deployments), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: Declare a `schedule` field on a workflow and Mastra will fire it on the cron you specify.
A schedule runs an agent on a cron cadence.
